summary: Each distribution server needs its own API token; Galaxy and Automation Hub docs explain how to get one.
questions: Can I reuse the same API token for Galaxy and Automation Hub?
Where do I get an API token for publishing collections?

answer_card.title: API tokens for distribution servers
answer_card.answer_md: You need a **separate API token for each server**. Get Galaxy tokens per the Galaxy docs and Automation Hub tokens per Red Hat's automation content docs.
